```{r}
#| label: setup

library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)
library(factoextra)

```

```{r}
polentometro_dim <- readRDS("data/derived/polentometro_dim.rds")

semdiff <- polentometro_dim |> 
  dplyr::select(CASE, educated:urban) |> 
  drop_na() %>%
  mutate(across(educated:urban, as.ordered))

semdiff_lik <- semdiff |> 
  select(-CASE)
```

```{r}
gower_dist <- daisy(semdiff_lik, metric = "gower")

hc <- hclust(gower_dist, method = "average")
```

```{r}
plot(hc, labels = FALSE, main = "Hierarchical Clustering Dendrogram (Average Linkage)")
```

```{r}
k <- 20
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)

# Add cluster assignment to data
semdiff$cluster <- factor(clusters)

table(semdiff$cluster)
```
